notes.title: Major Demo Update Version 0.8!
notes.content: [p]Version 0.8 of the demo is now live! This update adds new systems, buildings, and balance changes while also fixing a number of long-standing issues. Thank you to everyone who has been testing the demo and sending feedback. It’s making a huge difference as Repterra heads toward Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p]New in V0.8[/p][p][/p][p]New trophy reward system for completing levels[/p][p]Fixed uranium patch spawning killing bug[/p][p]Reworked promotion system, much easier to promote units now[/p][p]Reinforcements tip indicator (right click)[/p][p]New Pause Time Visual Effects, can be disabled in settings if you don’t like it[/p][p]Attack towers and power plants are now cheaper[/p][p]Bases now start with more ore nearby[/p][p]Flags and snow now pause when the time pauses[/p][p]Setting to invert mouse panning when control wheel held (settings->controls)[/p][p]Audio setting for Advisor voice only[/p][p]Added hotkey labels[/p][p]New Info hover button in HUD for unit/building expanded info[/p][p]Adjusted horde AI[/p][p]New stalking behaviour when enemies are chasing you[/p][p]Command center now provides more baseline dollars[/p][p]Balanced Insane difficulty[/p][p]New Scatter command (hotkey = comma)[/p][p]Updated harvesting preview system so it’s easier to see which tiles provide resources[/p][p]AI fixes[/p][p]New starcraft style left-click to attack move (must be enabled in settings->controls)[/p][p]New kill / tame counter for each unit[/p][p]Reworked notification system[/p][p]Supply crates now include many types of dinos[/p][p]Supply crates can now permanently clear fog around a large radius[/p][p]Supply crates now provide food, electricity, dino eggs, lumber, ore, uranium[/p][p]DNA points are awarded in crates, and an option in wave rewards[/p][p]Promoted units now have more health[/p][p]Dimos now have more visibility range[/p][p]New lookout tower building[/p][p]New Hospital capturable building[/p][p]Reworked AI to stop motionless bug[/p][p]New Outpost building[/p][p]Archelons can now transport human units[/p][p]Many bugs and AI fixes[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t yet, please consider leaving a review on the demo page. It only takes a moment and helps Repterra gain visibility on Steam while we keep improving the game. Stay tuned there is much more to come![/p]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - V0.7 and Tiny Teams Stream
notes.content: [p][b]Repterra V0.7 Now Live[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913111/69c1d8d0d423ed9e81c2314de1df122ed294ec70.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The V0.7 update is out. This build focuses on new features, balance changes, and a number of fixes that should make the game run smoother and play better:[/p][p][/p][p]Reworked settings UI, controls[/p][p]Newly reworked Audio System with advanced settings for each sound type (Master, Music, Effects, Interface, Ambient, Voice)[/p][p]Adjusted difficulty balancing (easy is easier, hard/very hard/insane are harder, normal stays the same)[/p][p]Resolved cursor input lag issue[/p][p]Breeding dinos now oscillate[/p][p]Economy multipliers (bank, warehouse etc) now have animated icons to show the buildings they affect[/p][p]Updated breeding indicators when max breeding capacity has been reached[/p][p]New Upgrade hotkey (U) . Toggle UI key is period, had to reset bindings file so you will have to redo any custom binding you made sorry about that[/p][p]Various balancing and improvements[/p][p]A notification will trigger if your dollar stockpile is full for too long[/p][p]Currency UI now shows a warning indicator when you are at max capacity[/p][p]Market now auto sells excess resources[/p][p]Changed add to selection hotkey to shift instead of ctrl[/p][p]alternate hover selection hotkey is backquote[/p][p]New UI toast for ‘Group X Created’ or selected[/p][p]Tamed dinos can now patrol[/p][p]Now easier to assign dinos to breedery, breedery can also be sold[/p][p]Dimorphodon and Archelon are now breedable[/p][p]Tamed enemy dinos can now be bred[/p][p]Adjusted balancing for tamers, slow effect, and baryonyx[/p][p]New Auto Ride feature, auto pairs riders with rideable dinos (hotkey R)[/p][p][/p][p]The Tiny Teams Fest is still running. Repterra will be featured on the official Tiny Teams stream on August 14th, so keep an eye out if you want to see it played live.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, feedback is appreciated. If you run into bugs, strange AI behavior, or balance issues, post them in the discussions or send them directly so they can be addressed in the next patch.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has been testing and sharing thoughts. Every bit of feedback helps make Repterra a better game. If you enjoyed the demo, please take a moment to leave a review here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268620/Repterra_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]-Repterra Team[/p]

notes.title: 🦖 Steam RTS Fest and Private Beta! 🦖
notes.content:

[h2]Development Update[/h2]

We’re deep in the grind, working tirelessly on some major features to elevate Repterra to the next level. Here’s a peek at what’s in progress:

🦖 Dinosaur Breeding: Build and manage thriving herds of dinos.
🧠 Taming Mechanics: Turn wild dinos into loyal allies.
🌍 Procedural World Generation: Endless new landscapes to conquer.

[previewyoutube=vkP1wpKOCUI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Private Beta[/h2]

We’re pushing hard toward a playable beta.

👉 Be sure to [url=https://chuteapps.com/repterra-beta/]sign up for the private beta[/url] to get first access and help shape the future of Repterra!

-REPTERRA Team

notes.title: Repterra Development Update September 2024
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I wanted to give a quick update, we are deep deep in development of Repterra.

We have most the core engine implemented. It's able to simulate 100k+ dinos at 200fps on our mahcines using parallel computing (the game is capped at 60fps so this efficiency should allow it to run well on older machines too).

A few cool things we've added so far:

-Flying dinos that spit acid from above (and anti-air cannons to shoot them down)
-Amphibious croc-like dinos that can emerge from the sea and attack your base on land.
-Soldiers that can deploy with sandbags, giving extra attack damage and range
-15+ base buildings
-Soldiers that can garrison neutral buildings on the map
-Roads, buildings, and urban environments
-Engineers that can capture neutral buildings
-Dino taming and breeding centers

We're working really hard to get the first playable version out asap. 

[url=https://chuteapps.com/repterra-beta]Sign up for our beta[/url] to get first access.

-Repterra Team
